preconditions.description: Input constraints: n is the number of problems (1 to 5000), m is the required balance (0 to 10^9).
Input is exactly two integers n and m separated by whitespace.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in stdout.strip().split()) and len(stdout.strip().split()) == n)
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output is '-1'. Otherwise, output is a sequence of exactly n positive integers, each ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (lambda a: all(int(a[i]) < int(a[i+1]) for i in range(len(a)-1)) and sum(1 for i in range(len(a)) for j in range(i+1, len(a)) for k in range(j+1, len(a)) if int(a[i]) + int(a[j]) == int(a[k])) == m)(stdout.strip().split())
postconditions.description: If output is not '-1', the sequence must be strictly increasing (a_1 < a_2 < ... < a_n) and contain exactly m triples (i, j, k) where i < j < k and a_i + a_j = a_k.
